title: Choosing a Chapter and Electing the Post-9/11 GI Bill
content:
**Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education) — terms on chapter choice, addressed to beneficiaries holding more than one chapter.**

1. **One chapter per period.** Two education chapters are never paid for the same period of training, because no tier pays two chapters concurrently. The student chooses which chapter each term is certified under.
2. **Election in place of a Montgomery GI Bill chapter.** Electing the Post-9/11 GI Bill in place of Chapter 30 or Chapter 1606 relinquishes that chapter irrevocably, and only the beneficiary can make that election.
3. **Entitlement on the election — retired.** The clause "A veteran who relinquished Chapter 30 for a single period of service receives Post-9/11 entitlement equal to the Chapter 30 months remaining at the election" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the Post-9/11 entitlement credited on an election.
4. **Basic pay reduction refund (in force).** A veteran who relinquished Chapter 30 receives the Chapter 30 basic pay reduction refund — the tier figure of $1200.00, prorated by unused Chapter 30 months — with the last housing payment when the Post-9/11 entitlement is exhausted.
5. **Chapter 35.** Chapter 35 cannot be relinquished for the Post-9/11 GI Bill.

**Election eligibility at a glance**

| Chapter held | Can it be relinquished to elect the Post-9/11 GI Bill | Who may make the election |
|---|---|---|
| Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) | Yes, irrevocably | Only the beneficiary |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606) | Yes, irrevocably | Only the beneficiary |
| Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance (Chapter 35) | No | — |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A beneficiary holding Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606 enrolls for a spring term: the term is certified under one of the two, chosen by the student, and only that chapter pays for it.

superseded_clauses: A veteran who relinquished Chapter 30 for a single period of service receives Post-9/11 entitlement equal to the Chapter 30 months remaining at the election
